name: Spotify
conditions: Unmodified icon only, monochrome (black on light / white on dark) unless on black/white
Min 21px; clear space = half icon height
Do not pair with our own branding over artwork; no implied partnership
paraphrase: Design guidelines govern partners using Spotify content/metadata (attribution with logo). No clause for a tracker referencing the service. Forbids altering the logo and pairing Spotify with other brands.
notes: Not a Spotify integration, so guidelines apply only by analogy. Wordmark-as-text safer.

name: Apple Music
paraphrase: Apple says third parties need an express written trademark licence for Apple-owned logos/graphic symbols; only word marks may be used referentially (e.g. 'compatible with') and less prominently than own name.
notes: Page does not name the Apple Music logo specifically; general rule applied. Plain text name is acceptable.

name: Apple Arcade
paraphrase: Same Apple rule: logos need express written licence; text word mark referential use only.
notes: Same note as Apple Music.

name: PlayStation Plus
conditions: If a logo is wanted: contact Sony Official Licensing Program
paraphrase: Sony notice lists marks and reserves rights; gives no third-party usage rules; points to an Official Licensing Program page (not read).
notes: Sony is a known IP enforcer; marks are stylised. Conservative fallback.

name: Xbox Game Pass
paraphrase: Microsoft guidelines say not to use its logos, icons or designs in any manner without permission; word marks may be used to accurately describe a product without implying endorsement.
notes: xbox.com/en-US/legal/trademarks returned 404. Text name OK.

name: Nintendo Switch Online
paraphrase: Nintendo's copyright page (read directly) bars third-party use of its logos/trademarks with non-Nintendo products or services or where customers could be confused, and says it generally declines permission requests.
notes: Known aggressive enforcer. Plain-text name only.

name: Discord Nitro
conditions: Unmodified Discord symbol in colour, black or white only
Only where Discord brand is clear nearby (else full logo)
Do not imply Discord affiliation; digital use only
paraphrase: Discord marks need permission for most uses; allowed to state you use Discord without implying affiliation; do not edit/recolour. No tracker-specific clause.
notes: Weak fit with the 'say you are a Discord user' allowance. Wordmark text safer.

name: Twitch Turbo / subs
paraphrase: Brand page only offers an official asset download; no stated rules on third-party use or permission found.
notes: Full guidelines not located.

name: LinkedIn Premium
conditions: If used: official asset only, unmodified, clearly separate from LinkedIn
paraphrase: LinkedIn allows use only as described in its guidelines or with express written permission, official assets only, must not suggest sponsorship; may ask you to stop.
notes: Close to RED on strictness.

name: Duolingo Super
paraphrase: Duolingo design site gives logo colour/clear-space/no-recolour rules but nothing on third-party permission; ToS reportedly grants no trademark licence (secondary summary).
notes: Mascot is distinctive; character art riskier than wordmark.

name: Udemy (courses / Personal Plan)
paraphrase: Udemy trademark guidelines (search summary of official support page; direct fetch returned 403) require Udemy written permission for its logos.
notes: Primary page still unreadable (HTTP 403); not confirmed first-hand.

name: Snapchat+
paraphrase: Snap Kit guidelines name the Ghost logo as something third-party apps must not use as their own branding; ads may not use Snap trademarks outside brand guidelines. No general referential-use rule found.
notes: Context is developer/ad programmes, not identification use; leaning RED if challenged.

name: Anghami
paraphrase: No public brand guidelines found. SDK licence says Anghami is a trademark and marks must follow guidelines supplied under a developer agreement.
notes: Unofficial logo aggregators are not a licence.

name: Deezer
paraphrase: Official guidelines (reportedly deezerbrand.com) not retrieved; only aggregator pages found, one marking the logo editorial-use-only.
notes: Check deezerbrand.com manually.

name: Audible
paraphrase: No Audible-specific policy found. Amazon's ad policy says Amazon marks beyond the 'available at Amazon' logo need written approval; its trademark guidelines target licensees and bar altering logos or implying endorsement.
notes: Amazon is a heavy brand enforcer; policy is for advertising/licensees, not identification use.

name: Storytel
paraphrase: No official logo usage guide found; press room exists at press.storytel.com (not inspected for terms).

name: Kindle Unlimited
paraphrase: No Kindle-specific logo policy found. Amazon's ad policy lists 'Kindle' among terms third parties may not use in ads without approval.
notes: Same Amazon caveats as Audible.

name: YouTube Music Premium
paraphrase: YouTube brand hub (via search summary) requires approval via a form for some contexts, forbids altering the logo, and says the logo should not be used alone without approval; API branding rules forbid implying endorsement.
notes: YouTube Music icon not specifically covered. Google 'Third Party Use' terms require consent for uncovered uses.

name: Scribd / Everand
paraphrase: No official Scribd/Everand brand guidelines found.
notes: Owner's brand pages not located.

name: EA Play
paraphrase: No EA Play logo policy found; EA's tournament guidelines forbid implying EA endorsement and note EA has not cleared third-party content.

name: Ubisoft+
paraphrase: No Ubisoft logo/Ubisoft+ policy found; video policy covers game footage only.

name: Google Play Pass
paraphrase: Google pages (via search summary) say uses beyond the guidelines need prior written consent, Google Play-mark creatives need brand-team approval, and Google logos must not be used in app icons.
notes: Guidelines target developers promoting their apps; Google Brand Resource Center not read. Could soften to YELLOW on review. Text name acceptable.

name: Roblox Premium
paraphrase: Roblox usage guidelines (via search summary) say the logo is not allowed except via the official badge, limited to select partners, and unsolicited requests are not granted.

name: Fortnite Crew
paraphrase: Epic bars creators from using Fortnite/Epic logos in experiences or their promotion; says third-party logos generally need the rightsholder's permission. No rule for trackers.
notes: Creator-programme terms apply only by analogy; leaning RED.

name: Coursera Plus
paraphrase: Coursera press page (read) has no usage rules; points to a press kit and press@coursera.org.
notes: No explicit permission or prohibition found.

name: Skillshare
paraphrase: ToS reportedly grants no right to use Skillshare trademarks/logos (secondary summary only).
notes: Primary ToS not read.

name: MasterClass
paraphrase: No official guidelines found; affiliate material says supplied creatives must be used as-is (secondary).

name: Telegram Premium
paraphrase: No official Telegram brand guidelines found; ToS page read contains none.
notes: Check telegram.org/tos/brand manually.

name: X Premium
paraphrase: Only developer display requirements found (X logo shown with X content); no general third-party logo policy; brand toolkit page returned 402.

name: Tinder
paraphrase: No official brand/press guidelines found.
notes: Match Group is an active IP enforcer; flame is a distinctive mark.

name: Bumble
paraphrase: No official brand/press guidelines found.
